hooks.command: if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/works-on-my-codex/scripts/womc_check.py"; else printf '%s\n' 'WOMC warning: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is not set; skipping harness check.' >&2; fi
hooks.commandWindows: if defined CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (python "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\works-on-my-codex\scripts\womc_check.py") else (echo WOMC warning: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is not set; skipping harness check. 1>&2)
